answer: The basalt explorer shows the whole merge tree. Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded ivory account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. That is 3 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
